metaDescription: Kevin reacts to a Peter Thiel interview, examining a clipped 'evil is competent' quote, Thiel's democracy comments, and his views on AI and longevity.
summary: Kevin reacts to a Peter Thiel interview, covering a viral 11-second clip in which Thiel says evil people are at least competent. Kevin argues the clip was taken out of context and that Thiel was speaking philosophically about bad versus evil, but still says he stands by calling transhumanists the worst. He discusses Thiel's 2009 comment about freedom and democracy, his libertarian claims and political funding, his remarks on slowing AI and longevity, and Kevin's view that Thiel hopes to upload his mind and merge it with AI.
